descriptions.d24f_record_vector_resize_80348a4c: Resizes the record vector at +24 to n: builds a default record (null interfaces, array via 0x802109dc); shrinking destroys the tail (array via 0x80210abc, interfaces via slot 16) and moves finish, growing calls the repeated insert 0x80347dec. Destroys the default record, stores n at +20 and returns 0.
